CustomField.description: To check if record is eligible to have notification generated that it is about to expire
CustomField.formula: ( UPPER(TEXT(Lead_Originator__c)) = "CCRM" || UPPER(TEXT(Lead_Originator__c)) = "ADOBE" || UPPER(TEXT(Lead_Originator__c)) = "UNICA" ) && ( RecordType.Name = "Commercial CRM Lead" ) && ( IF( Expiry_Date__c >= TODAY(), CASE( WEEKDAY(TODAY()), 1, IF( Expiry_Date__c = TODAY(), 1, 0), 7, IF( Expiry_Date__c = TODAY(), 1, 0), 6, IF( Expiry_Date__c <= TODAY() + 3, 1, 0), IF( Expiry_Date__c <= TODAY() + 1, 1, 0)) = 1, CASE( WEEKDAY(TODAY()), 1, IF( Expiry_Date__c + 2 <= TODAY(), 1, 0), 7, IF( Expiry_Date__c + 2 <= TODAY(), 1, 0), 0) = 1 ) )
CustomField.label: Expiry Notification Check
